claims.title: Wearable sleep is an estimate
claims.summary: Consumer wearables can overestimate sleep duration and efficiency; look for repeated patterns rather than treating a small nightly difference as exact.

claims.title: HRV alone is not a workout instruction
claims.summary: Trials of HRV-guided training have not established a clear endurance-performance advantage over predefined training. Interpret a reading with recent training and other context.

claims.title: A bigger week is not an injury prediction
claims.summary: Running injury risk has multiple interacting factors, and the available reviews are low quality. A change in mileage alone cannot estimate personal risk.
